content.comment_body: Hello everyone, hope you're doing well. Is anyone able to connect an IP camera to [product_name] WebServer? I am using the webcam component in [product_name] Web Editor, and I have set the camera's URL, but I can only access the camera when I'm on the local network. If I try from an external network, such as mobile data, the connection drops. Any advice on solving this issue? Regards, [user_name]

Hi, Based on what I know, the iframe control only works if your mobile phone can also reach the camera's video stream. You can find more details in the [product_name] manual, chapter 3.4, and in the [product_name] help section. Hope that helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing challenges viewing IP camera streams via [product_name] Web Editor's WebServer outside of the local network. The main user experience issue is the inability to access the camera stream remotely, which limits remote monitoring capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect uninterrupted access to the IP camera feed from [product_name] WebServer, regardless of whether they are connected through local or external networks.
